synopsis: SET Level is an on-road automated-driving research programme whose consortium published the Credible Simulation Process in August 2021; Chapter 7 also gives a broader 2021–2024 dating for the prostep ivip and SET Level process [f15692, f14592, f5216]. The process embeds simulation credibility in product development, scales credibility to simulation-task criticality, and addresses physical-data validation and transfer through process-level documentation [f15703, f8126, f8127]. For off-road automatic braking, the booklet treats it only as a process template: it is not proven for that application and does not specify the physical evidence still required [f8129, f8130, f8128, f15704]. Chapter 5 says SET Level was not verified in the research and calls for checks before reliance, while Chapter 11 reports agreement on the need for validation but no agreement on metrics [f4336, f9357]. For planning, the booklet recommends borrowing SET Level and related on-road programmes as a schedule reference class, noting that building validation capability took years in every documented case [f9614, f15717, f15713].
